name: Styanax Prime
description: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.

abilities.name: Axios Javelin
abilities.description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.

abilities.name: Tharros Strike
abilities.description: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.

abilities.name: Rally Point
abilities.description: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.

abilities.name: Final Stand
abilities.description: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.

languages.description: Schild der Unschuldigen. Speer der Gerechtigkeit. Styanax Prime hält die Stellung als Widerstand gegen die Tyrannei.
languages.name: Styanax Prime

languages.description: Bouclier des innocents, lance de justice, Styanax Prime résiste à la tyrannie.
languages.name: Styanax Prime

languages.description: Scudo degli innocenti. Lancia della giustizia. Styanax Prime resiste alla tirannia.
languages.name: Styanax Prime

languages.description: 무고한 자의 방패. 정의의 창. 스티아낙스 프라임은 폭정에 맞서 전선을 굳건히 지킵니다.
languages.name: 스티아낙스 프라임

languages.description: Escudo de los inocentes. Lanza de la justicia. Styanax Prime mantiene la línea contra la tiranía.

languages.description: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。

languages.description: Щит невинных. Копьё правосудия. Стинакс Прайм стоит на страже, бросая вызов тирании.

languages.description: 潔白の盾と、正義の槍。Styanax Primeは、暴政に立ち向かい戦線を守り抜く。

languages.description: Tarcza niewinnych. Włócznia sprawiedliwości. Styanax Prime staje przeciwko tyranii.

languages.description: Escudo dos inocentes. Lança da justiça. O Styanax Prime mantém a posição em desafio à tirania.

languages.description: Щит невинності. Спис правосуддя. Стейнекс-прайм тримає оборону супроти тиранії.
